messages.title: Hello Candy!
messages.body: Hiii! The mailbox works! By the way, what are Blaze Leaf's abilities? I'd love to try it before my early access expires!

HP: 300
Element: Firey

Damage: 75 + 50 Burn Damage(DOT)

mailbox.title: PvZ3+ — The Road to Version 1.0!
mailbox.body:
The beta era is coming to an end, and we're getting ready for the biggest milestone in PvZ3+ history!

On December 22, 2026, at 22:00 GMT, the Sewer Expansion Update will officially mark the end of Beta and the beginning of our Release Candidate (RC) phase!

What's next?

- December 22 — RC 1: Sewer Expansion Update
- December 27 — RC 2: Thunder Choy Update
- January 12 — RC 3: Cowbell Update
- February 5 — Version 1.0: THE BIG UPDATE!

🎉 The Big Update

Launching on February 5, 2027, at 17:00 GMT, The Big Update will mark the official full release of PvZ3+!

Get ready for:

- 16 announced new plants!
- 4 announced new zombies!
- Brand-new fusion combinations!
- Familiar faces returning to the lawn!
- The introduction of Sneak Stalk, a custom plant!
- And potentially even more surprises!

🎁 A special thank-you!

To celebrate the official launch, every player who joined PvZ3+ before Version 1.0 will receive a special reward when The Big Update releases!

This is our way of thanking everyone who has supported, played and been part of PvZ3+ throughout its development.

What is the reward? Well... that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? ;)

Thank you for being part of this journey. We're only getting started!

Stay tuned for more Dirt Sheet teasers and announcements!

— The PvZ3+ Team

kernelseed.name: Golden Harvest
kernelseed.specialMechanic: Every fifth action creates a free kernel-themed bonus attack or production, matching its normal role.

bopchoy.name: Jade Fist
bopchoy.specialMechanic: Every fifth attack strikes all zombies within two tiles, stunning for 3s.

cabbagepult.name: Siege King
cabbagepult.specialMechanic: Every fourth lob deals triple damage in a 3×3 area.

iceberglettuce.name: Absolute Zero
iceberglettuce.specialMechanic: Freeze effects last twice as long; every fifth activation freezes its entire lane for 8s.

limebomb.name: Citrus Cataclysm
limebomb.specialMechanic: Explosion covers a 5×5 area and leaves damaging citrus residue for 10s.

potatomine.name: Seismic Titan
potatomine.specialMechanic: Arms in 1s; explosion covers 3×3 and triggers a second blast after 2s.

spikeweed.name: Thorn Dominion
spikeweed.specialMechanic: Slows zombies on its tile by 50%; every fifth hit damages all zombies in its lane.

sunshroom.name: Solar Monarch
sunshroom.specialMechanic: Starts fully grown; every fifth production doubles nearby sun producers' next output.

tanglekelp.name: Abyssal Sovereign
tanglekelp.specialMechanic: Grabs up to three targets per activation; survives its first three normally consumptive activations.

umbrellaleaf.name: Celestial Canopy
umbrellaleaf.specialMechanic: Protects a 5×5 area; reflects intercepted attacks and grants protected plants 50% damage reduction.

zaptail.name: Thunder Monarch
zaptail.specialMechanic: Every fifth attack chains across the entire lawn, stunning targets for 2s.

cinderwood.name: Inferno Sovereign
cinderwood.specialMechanic: Fire amplification is tripled; nearby attacking plants gain burning attacks.

blover.name: Tempest Emperor
blover.specialMechanic: Blows away flying zombies across the lawn; pushes ground zombies three tiles back and slows them for 8s.

aloevera.name: Immortal Bloom
aloevera.design: Golden aloe leaves and healing halo
aloevera.specialMechanic: Heals a 3×3 area; every fifth heal grants a shield equal to 50% of each target's maximum HP.
